name: CherryTree Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Skips CherryTree anchors without a false PNG warning.
Gives distinct paths to names with no-break spaces.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Turning off the plugin during an import now stops new writes and keeps the notes and images already made.
tip: Export a CherryTree .ctb document as XML first, because the importer needs a .ctd file.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. CherryTree Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
